areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Formalization, training and calls for creative-economy workers plus an urban-art product; no dedicated product for the area, so impact is minor.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Economic inclusion and female entrepreneurship actions with measurable indicators; low score reflects limited resources and credit in related areas.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Housing upgrades, resettlement, basic services, drainage and public spaces; objectives, components and indicators fit, and it is the main area by impact and resources.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Nature-based solutions and recovery of degraded areas with a specific indicator, but objectives and products are mostly tied to other areas.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Drainage, slope containment and bioengineering reduce landslide risk; indicators sufficient though not fully focused on the area's results.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Vocational training and popular entrepreneurship with measurable indicators; small score due to resources and credit given in correlated areas.

areas.name: Poverty
areas.reason: Poverty-related actions were already credited under more suitable related areas, and no action specifically addresses hunger.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: Insufficient actions, no thematic centrality or consistent indicators; the isolated security-related products do not justify points.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Actions are concentrated in intra-urban areas of a single municipality, so the broader territorial integration the area requires is absent.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Participation was peripheral and not a priority among the specific objectives; insufficient detail.
